//BACK// The Wooden Horse
Whenever The Wooden Horse attacks, another target attacking creature can't be blocked this turn. Crew 3.
cards.story: Troy remembered / the long siege and the Wooden Horse

cards.name: The Phaeacian Games
cards.rules: I — Tap up to one target creature. Put a stun counter on it. II — Untap up to two target creatures you control. They gain flying until end of turn. III — Until end of turn, whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.

cards.name: Agamemnon, King Among Shades
cards.rules: Menace. When Agamemnon enters, if it was cast, mill three cards. When Agamemnon enters from your graveyard, each opponent sacrifices a creature.
cards.story: Book XI / Agamemnon among the dead

cards.name: The Trench of Blood
cards.rules: Whenever one or more creatures die, put a blood counter on The Trench of Blood. This ability triggers only once each turn. Remove three blood counters from The Trench of Blood: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a Spirit card, return it to the battlefield tapped instead. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.story: Book XI / blood summons the shades

cards.name: Elpenor, Unburied
cards.rules: Elpenor can't block. When Elpenor dies, mill two cards. Escape—{4}{B}, Exile three other cards from your graveyard. Elpenor escapes with a +1/+1 counter on it.

cards.name: Antiphates, Laestrygonian King
cards.rules: Menace. At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may sacrifice another creature or artifact. When you do, Antiphates deals damage equal to that permanent's mana value to up to one target creature an opponent controls and gains trample until end of turn.

cards.name: The Bag Is Opened
cards.rules: As an additional cost to cast this spell, return a land you control to its owner's hand. Create {X} 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with flying and haste, where {X} is one plus the number of other spells you've cast this turn. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step. Up to one target creature can't block this turn.
cards.story: Book X / the crew opens Aeolus's bag
cards.credit: Art: “River Landscape with Boar Hunt” · Joos de Momper II · Rijksmuseum

cards.name: Scylla Takes Six
cards.rules: Scylla Takes Six deals 3 damage to each of up to six target tapped creatures. If a creature dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
cards.story: Book XII / Scylla takes six sailors

cards.name: Wild Boar of Parnassus
cards.rules: When Wild Boar of Parnassus enters, up to one other target creature you control fights it. If a creature fought Wild Boar of Parnassus this way and is still on the battlefield, put two +1/+1 counters on that creature.
cards.story: Book XIX flashback / Odysseus receives his scar

cards.name: Herd of the Sun God
cards.rules: Vigilance. At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't sacrifice a permanent this turn, create a Food token. Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a stun counter on Herd of the Sun God. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.story: Book XII / sacred cattle of Helios

cards.name: The Olive Tree of Ithaca
cards.rules: Once each turn, whenever a permanent card enters the battlefield under your control from your graveyard or from exile, put a root counter on The Olive Tree of Ithaca. Permanents you control with counters on them have ward 1. Remove three root counters from The Olive Tree of Ithaca: Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.story: Books XXIII–XXIV / rooted home at Ithaca

cards.name: Tiresias, Seer Below
cards.rules: Foretell {U}{B}. When Tiresias enters, surveil 2. Once each turn, whenever you cast a spell from exile, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, draw a card, then discard a card.
cards.story: Book XI / Tiresias foretells the road home

cards.name: Leucothea, Sea-Borne Aid
cards.rules: Flash, flying. When Leucothea enters, exile up to one other target creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. If that creature was tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on it when it returns.
cards.story: Book V / Ino as Leucothea saves Odysseus

cards.name: Zeus, Arbiter of Fate
cards.rules: Indestructible. As long as your devotion to white and blue is less than seven, Zeus isn't a creature. Once each turn, whenever the final chapter ability of a Saga you control triggers, tap up to one target nonland permanent an opponent controls. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step. Draw a card.
cards.story: Books I, V, XXIV / divine arbitration

cards.name: The Sealed Winds of Aeolus
cards.rules: {T}: Put a wind counter on The Sealed Winds of Aeolus. {2}, {T}, Sacrifice The Sealed Winds of Aeolus: Return up to {X} target nonland permanents to their owners' hands, where {X} is the number of wind counters on it. If {X} is three or more, return a land you control to its owner's hand.
cards.story: Book X / Aeolus seals the winds

cards.name: Hermes's Golden Wand
cards.rules: {1}, {T}: Tap or untap target creature you control. If that creature is legendary, you may have it phase out instead.
cards.story: Books X–XI / Hermes guides and protects

cards.name: Penelope's Unbroken Oath
cards.rules: At the beginning of your end step, if no creature you control attacked this turn, put a thread counter on Penelope's Unbroken Oath. Remove three thread counters from Penelope's Unbroken Oath: Return target nonland permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.story: Books I–XXIII / Penelope waits and preserves the household

cards.name: Helios's Vengeance
cards.rules: Helios's Vengeance deals 6 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. Destroy all Vehicles. Helios's Vengeance deals 2 damage to you for each permanent you sacrificed this turn.
cards.story: Book XII / destruction after the cattle are slain

cards.name: Ogygia, Island Beyond Time
cards.rules: When Ogygia, Island Beyond Time enters, look at the top five cards of your library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. At the beginning of your end step, you may tap an untapped nontoken creature you control and put a stun counter on it. If you do, put a time counter on Ogygia. Remove three time counters from Ogygia: You may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost. Activate only as a sorcery.
cards.story: Book V / Ogygia hides a future outside ordinary time

cards.name: The Sirens' Song
cards.rules: At the beginning of combat on each opponent's turn, that player may draw a card. If they do, creatures they control attack you this combat if able. Whenever one or more creatures attack you, surveil 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.
cards.story: Book XII / irresistible song of the Sirens

cards.name: The Long Way Home
cards.mechanics: Journey counters / Exile Lane A / Exile Lane B / Vehicles / Manifest Fate
cards.rules: Whenever one or more cards are exiled from your library for the first time each turn, put a journey counter on The Long Way Home. Do the same whenever you cast your first spell from exile each turn or a Vehicle you control first attacks each turn. At your end step, remove three journey counters from it. If you do, manifest fate, then draw a card.
cards.story: Whole poem / every road bends toward Ithaca

cards.name: The Black-Hulled Ship, Homeward Bound
cards.rules: Ward {2}. Whenever The Black-Hulled Ship attacks, manifest fate. At the beginning of your second main phase, if The Black-Hulled Ship attacked this turn, you may exile up to one tapped creature you control, then return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step. Crew 3.
